crossRefs.note: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them: for he who has mercy on them will lead…
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.
For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself…
Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will…
In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.
Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat…
I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.
For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord…
a fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, flowing streams from Lebanon.
They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, to the new wine…
They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities…
My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

translations.web: and Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.
translations.bsb: The LORD will always guide you; He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land and strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
translations.kjv: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail
translations.asv: and Jehovah will guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in dry places, and make strong thy bones; and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
